page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 16 physical cores and 16 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, with 1.0 thread per core. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include any local storage or GPU hardware, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by bottom 25% scores in stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and text processing, alongside a bottom 10% result in single-threaded gzip compression. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression all placing in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also register average performance, though the Passmark memory score falls into the bottom 25% category.

Given its high memory density of 128.0 GB RAM alongside moderate multi-core CPU capacity, this instance offers a specialized resource profile. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-speed local storage or intensive single-threaded processing. The instance is suited for workloads such as database operations, Redis caching, static web serving, and moderate multi-threaded data processing, where the 8.0 GB per core memory allocation can be fully utilized.
